Once you have those, you can call the `ChartSeriesGenerator` function like this (replace the placeholder values with your actual data):

```javascript

  labels: ['Label 1', 'Label 2', 'Label 3'],          // <-- replace with your axis labels

  color: '#FF5733',                                   // <-- replace with your default color
  chartLayout: { title: 'My Chart', xAxis: {}, yAxis: {} } // <-- replace with your chart layout
});
```
